findings.text: _moment_flux writes out the plasma_target @ uniform + plasma_target_r @ radial + plasma_target_z @ vertical product that nova/biot/target.py:576 FluxTarget.internal already owns, and DisplayCoupling replaces the FluxTarget the plan named as the product to build, so the display path and the operator path can diverge; a per-chunk FluxTarget would extend the owner instead of forking it.

the _moments fixture zeroes both moment columns, so the radial and vertical terms contracted at display_flux.py:99-101 contribute nothing and a regression that dropped or swapped those columns would leave reproduction_relative_error at 0.0 with all three tests green.

the fragment and manifest.md:15 quote a negative-control relative error of 2.41e-4, but the log they cite, logs/negative_control.log:16-18, records 5.45e-4, so the recorded measure does not reconcile with its own log.

the brief required the fragment to carry the MAST CPU centroid X-point figure and none was drawn; the fragment states this plainly and the panel sections own the prescribing producer, but the requested evidence is absent.

the DEFAULT_SPACING docstring says "the plan fixes", a plan reference in source that the repository naming rules ban; the same appears at tests/test_display_flux.py:179 and :202, and tests/test_display_flux.py:30 refers to "the node".
